faqMultipleCampaignsTitle: Can I hire the same talent for multiple campaigns?
faqMultipleCampaignsDescription: Yes. If a creator's contract allows renewal, you can re-book them at the same rates (or renegotiate). Most creators prefer repeat work.
onePlatformForAICampaigns: One Platform For AI-Powered Creator Campaigns
theProblemWeSolveDescription: Your clients are moving to AI-powered creator content. Your team is juggling multiple vendors and platforms to source, manage, and deliver these campaigns. Likelee consolidates everything— verified creator licensing, production workflows, compliance, and brand exposure—into one streamlined platform so you deliver AI campaigns faster without building infrastructure.
streamlinedAICampaignWorkflowDescription: Brief → License creators → Manage AI production → Approve deliverables → Client handoff. Same workflow your team knows. 3-5 day turnaround. All creator licensing embedded in final assets.
directBrandExposureDescription: Brands discover your agency on Likelee when searching for AI campaign partners. Inbound pipeline. New business finds you because you're positioned as AI-campaign ready.
campaignsPerTeamPerMonth: AI campaigns per team per month
operationalSimplicityDescription: One dashboard replaces five tools for managing creator-licensed content. Your team doesn't learn new systems. No more spreadsheets tracking who licensed what. No more vendor coordination across compliance, licensing, and production.
fasterAICampaignDeliveryDescription: 2-3 weeks becomes 3-5 days because everything's in one place. Creator licensing is pre-cleared. Compliance is built in. No back-and-forth delays. Your clients see you as fast and capable of executing AI campaigns reliably.
newBusinessFromBrands: New Business From Brands Moving to AI
newBusinessFromBrandsDescription: Brands actively search Likelee for agencies that can execute verified creator AI campaigns. You get inbound leads just by being on the platform. Less cold calling. More inbound from brands shifting to AI- powered creator content.
leadAICampaignsDescription: Likelee gives you one platform for licensing verified creators, managing AI production, compliance, and brand exposure. Your team focuses on creative strategy. Your clients get faster AI-powered campaigns. You operate with less overhead while positioning as an AI-forward agency.

placeholders.tone: Upbeat and energetic, but not over-the-top. Natural enthusiasm that feels genuine.
placeholders.personality: Think "your stylish friend giving honest recommendations" rather than polished influencer.
placeholders.keyMessages:
• "Spring collection drops next week - these pieces are incredible"
• "Quality you can feel, style you can trust"
• "Perfect for everyday wear or special occasions"
• Call to action: "Shop now at urbanapparel.com"
placeholders.opening: Hook viewer with energy - "You guys! I just got early access to Urban Apparel's spring line..."
placeholders.middle: Show product features, talk about quality, fit, versatility. Be specific about what you love.
placeholders.closing: Clear CTA - "Link in bio to shop" or "Head to urbanapparel.com before it sells out"
placeholders.do:
• Be authentic and natural
• Show product in real-life settings
• Speak to camera directly
• Mention brand name at least once
placeholders.dont:
• Use competitor brands in frame
• Over-script - keep it natural
• Include controversial topics
• Disparage other brands
placeholders.requiredDeliverables:
Example:
3x Instagram Reels (15-30 seconds each)
1x Hero Image
5x Story Frames

Tip: Include quantity in each line so expected total is tracked automatically.
placeholders.colorPalette: Warm earth tones, natural lighting, bright but not oversaturated
placeholders.setting: Indoor/outdoor lifestyle settings - coffee shop, park, urban backdrop, home
placeholders.framing: Mix of close-ups and full-body shots. Show product clearly.
placeholders.editing: Clean, minimal cuts. Trendy but not overly filtered. Authentic feel.
placeholders.objective: Drive awareness and sales for Spring 2025 collection launch
placeholders.renewalTerms: Auto-renewal available at end of term. Brand must notify 14 days prior if not renewing.
placeholders.includedRevisions: 2 rounds of minor edits (color correction, text changes, music swaps)
placeholders.majorChanges: Require new brief and additional budget (e.g., re-shoot, complete re-edit)
placeholders.approvalProcess:
1 Creator submits deliverables to platform
2 Brand reviews and approves or requests revisions
3 Once approved, funds release from escrow to creator via Stripe
placeholders.watermarkProtection:
All delivered assets include embedded Likelee watermark for license verification and usage tracking.
DMCA Protection: Automatic takedown notices if assets used outside approved scope.
placeholders.legalTerms:
• Creator retains copyright; Brand receives usage license as specified
• SAG-AFTRA compliant terms and fair compensation standards
• Creator has right to approve final usage before publishing
• Brand cannot sublicense without creator consent
• Usage limited to approved channels, territories, and duration
